objective: Add a token-bucket rate limiter around the existing auth middleware

discover.purpose: Map auth middleware and find the request handler entry
discover.prompt: Read middleware/auth/*.rs and list functions that handle inbound requests. Report file paths and function signatures only — no rewrites yet.

plan_changes.prompt: From the discovered facts, draft a one-paragraph change plan that names the limiter crate, the wrap point, and the error path. No code yet.

implement.prompt: Implement the change plan. Update tests in middleware/auth/tests.rs. Run `cargo test -p auth` after each meaningful edit.
